lines.text: Ahaziah falls through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and sends messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron.
The angel of the LORD sends Elijah the Tishbite to meet the messengers and say the king will surely die.
The messengers describe a hairy man with a leather belt, and the king says it was Elijah the Tishbite.
The king sends captains with fifty men each to Elijah on a mountain, and fire from heaven consumes the first two companies.
The third captain begs on his knees, Elijah goes down to the king, and Ahaziah dies and Jehu succeeds him.
